scope: Host restart while a task-agent commission is waiting for a N.E.K.O PermissionGate answer before a protected runtime/capability action begins.

native_facts.effect_boundary: nekoclaw/runtime/execution.py asks the host with execution_action phase=begin before tool.execute is called. ExecutionAudit.begin waits for PermissionGate and exposes a receipt only after allow=true. Therefore a commission still waiting on the permission question has not begun the protected tool effect.
native_facts.grant_lifetime: PermissionGate session/once/run grants and scoped loans are intentionally in-memory and are invalidated with run/session/host lifetime. Only explicit persistent permission settings live in PermissionStore.
native_facts.pending_question: TaskAgentManager._ask stores PermissionAsk.to_json() as durable commission.pending_question and native outbox delivery before awaiting an in-memory Future.
native_facts.lost_continuation: After host restart the old Future, PermissionAsk.at_answer callback, scoped loan bindings and execution_audit worker are gone. TaskAgentManager._answer_closed currently refuses every non-report question.
native_facts.transcript_repair: nekoclaw/runtime/loop/tool_history.py::repair_tool_history synthesizes an error result 'Tool call interrupted by user' for an assistant tool call whose result is missing. _provider_context applies repair_tool_history before every provider request, so reopening the durable transcript does not replay the interrupted tool call.
native_facts.native_resume: TaskAgentManager._take_up_again already reopens a durable closed session/transcript and records resumed=true. The next actual tool call goes through the normal current PermissionGate and current policy again.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O current pin PermissionGate + ExecutionAudit + TaskAgentManager + transcript repair
reuse_order.reason: The native runtime already proves no protected effect started while the permission Future was pending, repairs the incomplete tool history, and can reopen the session.
No newer upstream host-restart permission continuation seam exists at review time.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O NekoClaw permission store / session / ledger / native outbox
reuse_order.reason: PermissionStore remains the only persistent permission authority; commission.pending_question/outbox remains the only pending-user-input durability; transcript repair/reopen remains the only runtime continuation.
No pinned provider or surface owns the host-internal PermissionGate Future or runtime transcript.

reuse_order.candidate: Mature durable workflow engines / approval stores
reuse_order.reason: Temporal/Restate-style workflow or approval persistence would add a second orchestrator/permission state authority. N.E.K.O already has the required durable checkpoint and transcript repair.

Preserve only task_agent permission waiting rows across reconcile and let _answer_closed turn the post-restart answer into a transcript continuation. Never recreate the old grant or execution receipt.
Would duplicate PermissionStore/PermissionGate and violate the single permission authority freeze.

do_not_preserve: direct plugin permission questions with no task-agent transcript continuation
generic tool questions not proven safe by this unit
any action for which an execution receipt was already issued
candidate_contract.answer_semantics: After restart, accept the answer only for the matching durable question_id. Append a resumed answer event and feed a host-authored continuation into the existing transcript-tail resume path.
candidate_contract.grant_semantics: The continuation MUST explicitly state that the earlier permission check was interrupted before the protected tool executed and that no once/session/always grant was restored. If the action is still needed the model must issue the tool again, which invokes the current PermissionGate/current settings again.
candidate_contract.choice_semantics: The user's choice may be included as context, but recovery code must not call PermissionStore.set_mode, create a scoped loan, recreate an execution receipt, or otherwise treat that choice as an authorization token.
candidate_contract.tool_history_semantics: Provider context relies on native repair_tool_history to pair the old unanswered tool call with a synthetic interruption result; the old tool call itself is never replayed.
candidate_contract.no_startup_effect: Opening the new host/ledger must not start a runtime/model turn or execute a tool; continuation starts only after an explicit matching user answer.

machine_acceptance: Pinned repair_tool_history still synthesizes 'Tool call interrupted by user' for a missing tool result.
A prior-host task_agent permission wait remains waiting_user after reconcile; a direct-plugin permission wait still fails closed.
Opening the new host starts no runtime/model/tool work.
A matching permission answer resumes the existing transcript with resumed=true but creates no PermissionGate session/run grant and changes no PermissionStore setting.
The provider sees the old tool call paired with the synthetic interruption result before the continuation message.
If the resumed model reissues the protected tool, the current PermissionGate asks again; exactly one real protected effect occurs only after that new approval.
A deny answer can be continued without any protected effect.
Existing report-wait restart, permission, execution-audit, tool-history and restart-failure regressions remain green.
retirement_condition: Delete this candidate when upstream N.E.K.O natively survives host restart during task-agent permission prompts without restoring stale once/session grants, replays no old tool call, rechecks current permission on any retried action, and has equivalent direct-plugin fail-closed plus transcript-repair coverage.
conclusion: THIN_NATIVE_CONTINUATION_CANDIDATE. Recover task continuity, not authorization state.
